 About the Company 
Bleckmann is a leading logistics expert specializing in the fashion and lifestyle industry. The company handles the distribution of clothing (both on hangers and packaged), shoes, accessories, and perfumes. 
Bleckmann works with seasonal collections-in October and November, they process summer clothing, and in the summer, winter clothing. They serve major European brands and retailers such as MS Mode and Obey. Work Environment 
Bleckmann has a modern, spacious warehouse with several sections. The temperature remains comfortable year-round. Employees wear their own clothes along with a mandatory safety vest. - A good command of the English language is required - Available Monday through Friday - Day shift: 7:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. - Full-time - 40 hours per week Salary
